expected_signature: Can not construct instance of com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JavaType
ownership_reason: Only the gold decides, per type, whether the general-purpose from-String deserializer handles it; hop 1 lists JavaType among the candidate types, hops 2 and 3 pass the candidates and the selection along, and hop 4 keeps exactly the candidates the decision accepts, so once the decision rejects JavaType no caller can recover it without restating the decision. The convention is pinned outside the gold: FromStringDeserializer.findDeserializer makes the same per-type decision and returns a Std of kind STD_JAVA_TYPE for JavaType.class (its _deserialize reads the value with TypeFactory.constructFromCanonical); TypeBase.serialize writes every JavaType as its canonical String, and TestTypeFactory testCanonicalNames pins that round trip; JdkDeserializers.find hands every listed type to findDeserializer. The gold's javadoc promises whether values of the type are deserialized from a JSON String by the general-purpose from-String deserializer, which holds for JavaType. A hard-coded JavaType at a hop, or in JdkDeserializers' own array, passes the existing tests but leaves the gold answering false for a type that deserializer handles, so the gold's and the facade's documented contracts stay violated.
